intuition: Two pointers separated by n nodes reach the target predecessor when the fast pointer reaches the end.

brute_force.approach: Count nodes, convert the position from the end to an index from the start, then remove that node.

optimal.approach: Start both pointers at a dummy node, advance fast n steps, then move both until fast reaches the tail and bypass slow.next.

edge_cases: Removing the head is handled by the dummy predecessor.
A one-node list removed with n=1 returns None.
Advance fast exactly n nodes so slow stops immediately before the target.
